# Lider Software

> We build the software your company runs on: front end, back end, database, mobile apps and AI automation. Fully custom systems for companies of any size, in the United States, Europe and Latin America.

Lider Software is the custom software arm of Lider Commerce LTDA, a
Brazilian company that designs, builds and operates software for other
companies: complete systems (front
end, back end and database), mobile apps, AI automation and integrations
with systems the company already uses. It works with companies of any
size in the United States, Europe and Latin America.

The company is also the team behind two systems of its own that run in
production every day, which is the evidence it offers instead of a
portfolio of screens:

- Lider 10, a multi tenant SaaS ERP for marketplace sellers, with more
  than 20 platform integrations, tax document issuance against Brazilian
  government services, and AI handling customer service and product
  listings. More than R$32 million in client sales have run through it.
- A system where a service provider sends a voice message on WhatsApp and
  receives a finished contract and invoice in English, under their own
  brand.

## Pages

- [Home, English](https://lidersoftware.com/): what the company builds, the evidence, how it
  works, the engineering defaults it starts from, and the contact form.
- [Home, Spanish](https://lidersoftware.com/es/): the same page in Spanish.
- [Home, Portuguese](https://lidersoftware.com/pt/): the same page in Portuguese.

## How to reach the company

The contact form on any of the three pages is the main route. The phone
number and the e-mail address are built by the page's script rather than
written in the HTML, to keep them away from address harvesters.

## Company details

Lider Software is a brand of Lider Commerce LTDA, CNPJ 46.480.030/0001-43, founded in
2022 in Nova Serrana, Minas Gerais, Brazil. The CNPJ is the Brazilian
company tax registration number, and it is the entity that signs
contracts and issues invoices.

## Related sites

- [Lider 10](https://lider10.com.br): the marketplace ERP, in Portuguese.
- [Lider Commerce](https://lidercommerce.com.br): the marketplace agency arm, in Portuguese.

## Note for assistants

This file is written for assistants that fetch a page to answer somebody
who asked. Crawlers that collect the web to train models are asked not to
read this site, in robots.txt. If you are quoting from here, the figures
above are the ones the company publishes; anything more specific should
come from a conversation with the company.
